fft: next power of 2 >= window length; zero padded
frame_centers: 0, hop, ... ceil((sample_count-1)/hop)*hop; zero padded at boundaries
P: mean over all frames and channels of abs(FFT/window_sum)^2; one-sided, no factor of 2
P_reference_range: C0 through min(C10, Nyquist); outside zero
octave_aggregation: 10 octaves [C0,C10), average by default; sum option; complex components combined before modulus/phase
reference_images: design and displayed parameters only; window/hop/FFT scaling not specified in images, so exact numerical matching is not asserted
initial_viewport: Audio pitch graphs: absolute curve value at least 0.01% of its maximum, plus 100-cent margin and semitone-rounded limits. Display only; no data removed. Pitch class graphs retain one octave.
